logline: A seasoned police officer and a retired journalist with a fractured shared history team up to untangle a murder in Mumbai's Mahim district, uncovering a city's hidden margins of longing and desperation.

renewal.note: Eight-episode limited series based on Jerry Pinto's novel of the same name. No second season announced.

bollymeter.basis: Vijay Raaz and Ashutosh Rana's pairing anchored strong audience reception; critics praised the adaptation of Jerry Pinto's novel for its atmospheric handling of Mumbai's marginalised communities and the restrained performances of its two leads.

seasons.review_body: Murder in Mahim arrived on JioCinema in May 2024 as an adaptation of Jerry Pinto's award-winning novel of the same name, bringing to screen a whodunit set in Mumbai's Mahim district that is as much about the city's invisible communities as it is about the crime at its centre. Director Raj Acharya assembled two of Hindi cinema's most reliable character actors - Vijay Raaz and Ashutosh Rana - as the investigative duo whose complicated history mirrors the moral complexity of the case they are solving. The show engaged seriously with LGBTQ life in urban Mumbai, following the source material's lead rather than softening it for the platform. The eight-episode runtime kept the pacing disciplined, and the two lead performances ensured emotional credibility across the investigation.
